item.title: Top 7 Methods to Calculate the Angle Between a Line and the Horizontal Axis
item.description:
In many programming scenarios, determining the angle between a line segment and the horizontal axis is crucial, particularly in applications involving geometry or graphical representations. But how can we achieve this calculation effectively in different programming languages?

Here, I’ll present seven distinct methods you can use to calculate the angle between two points, denoted as (P1x, P1y) and (P2x, P2y), ensuring that you accurately accommodate the coordinate system where the y-axis typically increases downwards, as is common in graphic applications.
